'''Arum Oru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]], who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Oru was from [[Antar 4/Legends|Antar IV]] and became a [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he competed in the [[Cularin Classic]] [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race, on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].

==Personality and traits==
Oru was competitive, but not aggressively so. He wanted to prove the ability of his swoop team and his swoop, so he tried to perform to a consistent standard on the swoop circuit, rather than aiming for solitary wins.
